Given a dedicated wrapper function (matching Get-SPOTenantRest/Get-PowerPlatform*Rest/Get-Teams*Rest) so CommandTracker tracks a meaningful, product-specific command name instead of the generic Invoke-ScubaRestMethod primitive name. Previously calling Invoke-ScubaRestMethod directly caused the Rego dependency-check 'Commandlet' metadata to reference the primitive itself, which broke when it didn't match the tracked command name.
